# Vendored TalkTalk WASM

These files are generated from [`nakajima/talk` commit `5ea05b12af51a91bf51e0abb7b4afd429dea3db2`](https://github.com/nakajima/talk/commit/5ea05b12af51a91bf51e0abb7b4afd429dea3db2).

Regenerate them from a clean checkout of that commit:

```sh
cd wasm
npm run build
```

Then copy `pkg/talk_wasm.js`, `pkg/talk_wasm.d.ts`, and
`pkg/talk_wasm_bg.wasm` into this directory. Do not edit generated files by
hand.
